product.title: Sandbox Impact Model
product.summary: Change a league rule, run the model, and argue from what it shows.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students draft a change to a league rule set — a cap growth rate, a tax bracket, a revenue-sharing rate — and run it against the baseline. The model returns parity, tax concentration, revenue inequality and small-market competitiveness, and students interpret the result inside a formal rule-change proposal.

delivery.devices: one browser per student, with an account

facilitation.prep: A commissioner account manages class codes, invites and proposal review.

product.technology: Next.js, Prisma + PostgreSQL, NextAuth, server-side simulation

studentDataProfile.notes: Requires account creation. Stores proposals, evidence and commissioner decisions. Descriptive only.

governance.maturityBasis: A real simulation engine with unit tests behind a research-and-proposal workflow. No deployment and no student-run evidence.

health.technicalBasis: No live URL found; requires a Postgres deployment to run.
knownBlockers: No deployment, so an instructor cannot run it today.

governance.notes: Deliberately rejects the arcade framing the other BOW platforms use, in favour of research and proposal writing. Whether that is an active direction or a parked experiment is not resolvable from the repository.

provenance.evidence: bow-universe/src/lib/sim.ts implements simulateSeason, calculateLuxuryTax and compareRuleOutcomes; prisma/schema.prisma declares GradeBand of GRADE_5_6 and GRADE_7_8; README describes 'a research-first fictional sports-economy league for grades 5 through 8'.
